name: Himouto! Umaru-chan
description:
People are not always who they appear to be, as is the case with Umaru Doma, the perfect high school girl—that is, until she gets home! Once the front door closes, the real fun begins. When she dons her hamster hoodie, she transforms from a refined, over-achieving student into a lazy, junk food-eating otaku, leaving all the housework to her responsible older brother Taihei. Whether she's hanging out with her friends Nana Ebina and Kirie Motoba, or competing with her self-proclaimed "rival" Sylphinford Tachibana, Umaru knows how to kick back and have some fun!

Himouto! Umaru-chan is a cute story that follows the daily adventures of Umaru and Taihei, as they take care of—and put up with—each other the best they can, as well as the unbreakable bonds between friends and siblings.

videos.title: Umaru-chan One More Time!
videos.overview: Unaired episode of Himouto! Umaru-chan included with the manga's seventh compiled volume.

videos.title: The Secret Umaru-chan
videos.overview: Unaired episode of Himouto! Umaru-chan included with the manga's tenth compiled volume.

videos.title: Umaru and Her Brother
videos.overview: Responsible Taihei has to deal with his lazy little sister, Umaru, who trashes his apartment and throws tantrums to get manga and junk food.

videos.title: Umaru and Ebina
videos.overview: Taihei comes home to a complete stranger: Umaru’s public face. She’s cleaned the apartment and hidden her games to be able to invite her classmate and neighbor, Ebina, over.

videos.title: Umaru and Her Disciple
videos.overview: Umaru’s sulky, glaring classmate, Motoba, has unexpectedly shown up at her door… while she’s wearing her hood! Is her secret out?

videos.title: Umaru and Her Rival
videos.overview: Umaru, aka UMR, is a force to be reckoned with in the arcade. She’s invited to participate in a fighting game championship only to bump into her school rival, Tachibana.

videos.title: Umaru and Summer Vacation
videos.overview: Summer vacation means hours at the arcade! Umaru instructs in the fine art of enjoying summer like a (lazy) pro. Later, Taihei endures another typical day at work.

videos.title: Umaru’s Birthday
videos.overview: Taihei and Umaru experiment with free time and personal space in their little apartment, and playing “The Game of Life” hits too close to home for them all.

videos.title: Umaru’s Big Brother
videos.overview: People in his office have seen Taihei walking home and going shopping with a hot girl! His coworker comes over for a visit to see this so-called “sister” for himself.

videos.title: Umaru and Christmas and New Year's
videos.overview: In the Doma household, winter means lazy days beneath the kotatsu! Umaru reflects on her interesting year while Taihei tries to collect on a promise she made to him.

videos.title: Umaru and Valentine’s
videos.overview: It’s Valentine’s Day! Kirie burns cookies, Ebina attempts to make chocolate, and Umaru continues to offload food prep to Taihei.

videos.title: Umaru and Now and Once Upon a Time
videos.overview: Umaru gets sick, but it’s a good thing her germs are as lazy as she is! Sadly, her germs show her brother no mercy. Later, Taihei remembers a day at the arcade, 10 years ago.

videos.title: Umaru's Everyday Life
videos.overview: Umaru and Ebina discover that their appetites match, the council in Umaru’s head furiously debates about the perfect snack, and Taihei tries to get Kirie excited for summer.

videos.title: Umaru and Everyone
videos.overview: In this last episode of the season, Umaru might have to reveal her secret when her separate circles of friends come together during a much anticipated trip to the beach!

videos.title: The Himouto Returns
videos.overview: Umaru Doma's life continues with an evening filled with video games... and no big brother in sight! Later, Umaru and her friends end up playing an intense game of soccer.

videos.title: Umaru and Alex
videos.overview: Taihei invites his coworkers over for dinner after work, and one of them, Alex, catches Umaru's attention. Why does this guy seem so familiar, and what's his deal with anime?

videos.title: Umaru and Friends
videos.overview: Alex interrupts Kirie and Umaru's afternoon to play a dating sim game. Kirie finds herself identifying with the main character. Later, Umaru discovers an addictive new game.

videos.title: A Party with the Whole Gang
videos.overview: Umaru spends Christmas evening with her friends, and Sylphyn remembers a childhood Christmas wish. On New Year's morning, Umaru receives a suspicious gift from Taihei.

videos.title: Big Brother Departs
videos.overview: Taihei leaves for a business trip with his co-workers. While his boss Kanau thinks of a way to spend time with him, Taihei has his hands full with a vacation-happy stowaway.

videos.title: Umaru and Dreams
videos.overview: While visiting Umaru, Kirie’s secret aspiration is found out! Will Umaru’s encouragement be enough to help Kirie overcome her self-doubt?

videos.title: Umaru and Amusement Parks
videos.overview: Umaru and the girls head out to spend a fun day at the amusement park, but Kirie is having a few struggles. Will the day end up a total disaster?

videos.title: Umaru and Hikari
videos.overview: Umaru and the gang have a spontaneous get-together, but when things don't go as expected, hilarity ensues.

videos.title: Umaru and Memories
videos.overview: After Bomba gives Taihei one of his old cameras, Taihei spends sometime reconnecting with Umaru. Later, the tension between Hikari and Umaru increases.

videos.title: First Time for Everyone
videos.overview: Sylphin invites UMR over to her house, where a slight misunderstanding leads to some awkwardness. Later on, Umaru seems to have found a weakness in Hikari’s armor.

videos.title: Umaru and the Starry Sky
videos.overview: Kirie devises a new plan to bring Ebina and Taihei closer. However, Taihei might have a couple to many little sisters fighting for his attention already.

videos.title: Everyone and Umaru
videos.overview: It's the end of the year, and everyone is figuring out what Christmas gifts to get their loved ones. Can Umaru and the others find the perfect presents?
